answer: Admissions at Raigad International School are open from January to March each year. You can apply online through our Admissions page or visit the campus Monday–Saturday between 9 AM and 4 PM. Required documents include birth certificate, previous mark sheets, and passport-size photographs.

Our fee structure varies by grade. Nursery–Grade 2: ₹45,000/year; Grades 3–7: ₹55,000/year; Grades 8–10: ₹65,000/year; Grades 11–12: ₹75,000/year. Merit scholarships are available. Please visit our Admissions page for the full fee schedule.

Raigad International School follows the CBSE curriculum from Nursery to Grade 12, enriched with international pedagogical practices. We offer Science, Commerce, and Humanities streams at the senior secondary level.

Our campus features fully equipped Science and Computer labs, a 10,000-book library, an indoor sports complex, swimming pool, art studio, music room, and a 400-m running track surrounded by the Sahyadri foothills.

We provide school bus services covering Panvel, Kharghar, Kalamboli, New Panvel, and surrounding areas. Routes are updated each academic year. Please contact the transport office at transport@raigadschool.edu.in.
School hours are Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 2:30 PM. Saturday is a half-day from 8:00 AM to 12:30 PM. The administrative office is open from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on all working days.

Raigad International School is located near Panvel, Raigad District, Maharashtra. You can reach us at: 📞 +91 90000 00000 | 📧 info@raigadschool.edu.in | 📍 Near Raigad Fort Road, Panvel, Maharashtra 410206.
We offer merit-based scholarships of 10%–50% fee waiver for students scoring above 85% in previous board exams. Need-based assistance is also available. Contact our admissions office for details.
We host a rich calendar of events including the annual Sahyadri Cultural Fest, Science Olympiad, Inter-school Sports Meet, and Raigad Heritage Day. All events are listed on our Events page.

Our faculty comprises 80+ experienced educators, many with M.Ed. and Ph.D. qualifications. Our Principal, Dr. Sunita Patil, has over 25 years of educational leadership experience. Meet our team on the Faculty page.
